# `Sequence`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Legacy autosave sequence and frame transitions.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifySequence @0xaf7f0, AutoSavePlan @0x30ea00, AutoSaveSequences @0x217d80 (start @0x217e2c), AutoSaveExpProcess @0x216e20 (frame_complete @0x217670), CamExpose @0x2189d0 (complete @0x2192dc, fail @0x219acc), plan-progress helper NotifyPlan @0xb2040 (callers near @0x30cef0, @0x30d088) (64-bit build) |

Legacy producers (AutoSavePlan, AutoSaveSequences, camera exposure) send one event per sequence/frame transition, through the state family (state, plus error/code when code > 0) or the custom NotifySequence (state plus id, frame, total_lapse_frame, total_frame). Inside a legacy plan run, the plan-progress helper sends frame_start and frame_complete with state and progress only (the same object as get_app_state progress). In a sequence-list run, start and complete carry state only, fail adds error and code (253 is a client stop), and frame_complete alone carries id, frame, total_lapse_frame and total_frame; frame_start is sent only inside a legacy plan run. No lapse_ms or route. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. The APK defines the name only; no app event branch is established. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Sequence"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Caller-supplied literal. One of: `start`, `frame_start`, `frame_complete`, `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `id` | integer | if state frame_complete in a sequence-list run (NotifySequence producer) | - | Sequence id. [READ] |
| `frame` | integer | if state frame_complete in a sequence-list run (NotifySequence producer) | - | Started or completed frame index. [READ] |
| `total_lapse_frame` | integer | if state frame_complete in a sequence-list run (NotifySequence producer) | - | Completed frame total across the sequence. [READ] |
| `total_frame` | integer | if state frame_complete in a sequence-list run (NotifySequence producer) | - | Planned frame total. [READ] |
| `progress` | object | if plan-progress producer (frame_start, frame_complete inside a legacy plan run) | - | Legacy plan progress; same formatter output as get_app_state progress. [READ] |
| `progress.targets` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.targets.total` | integer | no | - | Planned target total. [READ] |
| `progress.targets.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed planned target count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_plan` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_plan.total` | integer | no | - | Current-plan total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_plan.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed current-plan count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_target` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.total` | integer | no | - | Target total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed target count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_target.target_name` | string | no | - | Current target name; empty when there is no current target. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_target.id` | integer | no | - | Target id; -2147483648 when there is no current target. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq` | object | no | - | [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.total` | integer | no | - | Sequence frame total. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.lapse` | integer | no | - | Completed sequence frame count (a count, not milliseconds); 'completed' is inferred from the counter names. [READ; completed-count meaning INFERRED] |
| `progress.cur_seq.frame_type` | string | no | - | Frame type name. light, dark, bias or flat for codes 0 to 3; unknown otherwise, including when there is no current sequence. One of: `light`, `dark`, `bias`, `flat`, `unknown`. [READ] |
| `progress.cur_seq.id` | integer | no | - | Sequence id; -2147483648 when there is no current sequence. [READ] |
| `progress.plan_end` | boolean | no | - | End flag; false when no plan run is current. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if supplied code > 0 | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if supplied code > 0 | - | Supplied error code. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, frame-complete - Frame done (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Sequence","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"frame_complete","id":2,"frame":5,"total_lapse_frame":15,"total_frame":30}
```

Event, plan-frame-start - Frame start inside a legacy plan run (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Sequence","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"frame_start","progress":{"targets":{"total":2,"lapse":0},"cur_plan":{"total":2,"lapse":0},"cur_target":{"total":30,"lapse":12,"target_name":"Example target","id":1},"cur_seq":{"total":30,"lapse":12,"frame_type":"light","id":1},"plan_end":false}}
```
